title_ja: 当社の業務委託先におけるランサムウェア被害に伴う個人情報等漏えいのおそれについて
title_en: Regarding the risk of leakage of personal information due to a ransomware attack at our outsourcing contractor
summary_en: On 11 July 2025, Credit Agricole Life Insurance announced that its outsourcing contractor, Shinchosha Co., Ltd., suffered a ransomware attack that may have exposed personal information. The insurer says no leak or misuse of the data it entrusted to the contractor has been confirmed so far. The contractor has commissioned a specialist firm to investigate. If a leak is confirmed, the insurer will promptly contact the customers affected. It has set up a customer service line for enquiries.

title_ja: お客様情報の漏えいについてお詫びとご説明
title_en: Apology and explanation regarding the leak of customer information
summary_en: Crédit Agricole Life Insurance announced on 10 December 2025 that the investigation by its claims-verification contractor, Shinchosha, confirmed a leak of some customers' data. Shinchosha's servers were hit by ransomware, discovered 27 June 2025. The leaked items were names, phone numbers, application numbers and case numbers, but not for every customer. No secondary harm has been confirmed. Affected customers are being contacted individually, and the insurer has paused new verification requests to Shinchosha until its safeguards are checked.
